# transformers.activations

## transformers.activations

- `AccurateGELUActivation()` — Applies GELU approximation that is faster than default and more accurate than QuickGELU. See: https://github.com/hendrycks/GELUs
- `ClassInstantier` — Dictionary that remembers insertion order
- `ClippedGELUActivation(min: float, max: float)` — Clip the range of possible GeLU outputs between [min, max]. This is especially useful for quantization purpose, as it allows mapping negatives values in the GeLU spectrum. For more information on this trick, please refer to https://huggingface.co/papers/2004.09602.
- `FastGELUActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Applies GELU approximation that is slower than QuickGELU but more accurate. See: https://github.com/hendrycks/GELUs
- `GELUActivation(use_gelu_python: bool = False)` — Original Implementation of the GELU activation function in Google BERT repo when initially created. For information: OpenAI GPT's GELU is slightly different (and gives slightly different results): 0.5 * x * (1 + torch.tanh(math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) * (x + 0.044715 * torch.pow(x, 3)))) This is now written in C in nn.functional Also see the Gaussian Error Linear Units paper: https://huggingface.co/pape
- `GELUTanh(use_gelu_tanh_python: bool = False)` — A fast C implementation of the tanh approximation of the GeLU activation function. See https://huggingface.co/papers/1606.08415.
- `LaplaceActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Applies elementwise activation based on Laplace function, introduced in MEGA as an attention activation. See https://huggingface.co/papers/2209.10655
- `LinearActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Applies the linear activation function, i.e. forwarding input directly to output.
- `MishActivation()` — See Mish: A Self-Regularized Non-Monotonic Activation Function (Misra., https://huggingface.co/papers/1908.08681). Also visit the official repository for the paper: https://github.com/digantamisra98/Mish
- `NewGELUActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Implementation of the GELU activation function currently in Google BERT repo (identical to OpenAI GPT). Also see the Gaussian Error Linear Units paper: https://huggingface.co/papers/1606.08415
- `OrderedDict` — Dictionary that remembers insertion order
- `PytorchGELUTanh(use_gelu_tanh_python: bool = False)` — A fast C implementation of the tanh approximation of the GeLU activation function. See https://huggingface.co/papers/1606.08415.
- `QuickGELUActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Applies GELU approximation that is fast but somewhat inaccurate. See: https://github.com/hendrycks/GELUs
- `ReLUSquaredActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — Applies the relu^2 activation introduced in https://huggingface.co/papers/2109.08668
- `SiLUActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — See Gaussian Error Linear Units (Hendrycks et al., https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.08415) where the SiLU (Sigmoid Linear Unit) was originally introduced and coined, and see Sigmoid-Weighted Linear Units for Neural Network Function Approximation in Reinforcement Learning (Elfwing et al., https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.03118) and Swish: a Self-Gated Activation Function (Ramachandran et al., https://arxiv.org
- `SqrtSoftplusActivation(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None` — sqrt(softplus(x)) — the router scoring function used by DeepSeek V4.
- `Tensor` — class
- `XIELUActivation(alpha_p_init=0.8, alpha_n_init=0.8, beta=0.5, eps=-1e-06, dtype=torch.bfloat16, with_vector_loads=False)` — Applies the xIELU activation function introduced in https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.13010
- `get_activation(activation_string)` — function
- `is_torchdynamo_compiling() -> bool` — function
- `use_kernel_forward_from_hub(*args, **kwargs)` — function
